marketing.landing.cmd_body: Press ⌘K from anywhere in the app. Search bookmarks, jump to a slug, switch workspaces, or run any action — without lifting your hands from the keyboard.
marketing.landing.cmd_check_1: Type to search bookmarks, folders, and tags
marketing.landing.cmd_check_4: Slug disambiguation when multiple bookmarks share a slug
marketing.landing.cta_final_body: Sign up on the hosted service or self-host in minutes. No lock-in.
marketing.landing.cta_final_title: Your bookmarks, a short link away.
marketing.landing.feature_folders_desc: Group bookmarks into folders with colored indicators. Share specific folders with teammates.
marketing.landing.feature_pinned_desc: Pin your most-used links to the top. They surface first in the palette and on the dashboard.
marketing.landing.feature_sharing_desc: Each bookmark can be private, shared with specific people, or shared with the whole team workspace.
marketing.landing.feature_tags_desc: Multi-tag any bookmark. Filter by one or many tags across folders and scope.
marketing.landing.features_body: Save links, assign folders and tags, pin what matters. All your bookmarks, one keyboard shortcut away.
marketing.landing.hero_subtitle: SlugBase is a keyboard-driven bookmark manager. Assign a slug to any link, then jump to it from the command palette with go <slug> or your browser's search shortcut.
marketing.landing.pricing_body: The hosted service has a generous Free tier. Personal and Team plans unlock unlimited bookmarks, API access, and collaboration. Self-hosting is always free.
marketing.landing.selfhost_body: SlugBase is AGPL-3.0 licensed and available on GitHub. Run it on your own infrastructure with a single container.
marketing.landing.selfhost_comment_2: # First run creates the owner account.
marketing.landing.selfhost_title: Your data. Your server. Your rules.
marketing.landing.slug_body: Every bookmark can have a personal short slug. Invoke the command palette or configure a browser search engine shortcut. One keystroke, anywhere you are.
marketing.landing.slug_check_1: Personal slugs on your forwarding domain
marketing.landing.slug_check_2: Browser search shortcut: type your keyword plus slug
marketing.landing.slug_check_3: go <slug> mode in the command palette
marketing.landing.team_body: Create shared workspaces. Assign team members with role-based access. Share folders and bookmarks selectively — the rest stays private. Shared slugs forward for every team member who has access.
marketing.landing.team_check_3: Shared folders with granular member access
marketing.landing.team_check_4: Audit log for all workspace actions (Team plan)
marketing.landing.team_title: Share bookmarks and slugs with your team.

marketing.pricing.faq.cancel.answer: Your paid plan remains active until the end of the billing period. After that, your workspace returns to Free. If you have more than {cap} bookmarks, the excess are archived (not deleted) and restored automatically if you re-subscribe.
marketing.pricing.faq.cancel.question: What happens if I cancel?
marketing.pricing.faq.cap.answer: Your existing bookmarks and slugs continue to work unchanged. New bookmark creation is paused. Excess bookmarks are archived — not deleted — when you downgrade from a paid plan. They are restored automatically when you upgrade or re-subscribe.
marketing.pricing.faq.cap.question: What happens if I exceed the Free bookmark limit?
marketing.pricing.faq.data_hosting.answe: The SlugBase hosted service stores all data in EU-based infrastructure (Frankfurt). Data is encrypted at rest and in transit. No data is transferred outside the EU. Full details are in the
marketing.pricing.faq.personal_vs_team.a: Personal is for individual use: unlimited bookmarks, slugs, and API access for one account. Team adds shared workspaces, role-based member management, shared folders and slugs, SSO/OIDC, and audit logging.
marketing.pricing.faq.personal_vs_team.q: What is the difference between Personal and Team?
marketing.pricing.faq.self_hosted.answer: Yes. SlugBase is AGPL-3.0 licensed. You can run it on your own infrastructure at no cost, with no seat limits, no bookmark caps, and full feature parity. You are responsible for hosting costs and maintenance.
marketing.pricing.faq.switch_plans.answe: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period. Your bookmarks and slugs are never affected by a plan change.
marketing.pricing.faq.switch_plans.quest: Can I switch plans at any time?
marketing.pricing.headline: Honest pricing. No surprises.
marketing.pricing.selfhost_body: SlugBase is AGPL-3.0. Run it on your own server — no seat limits, no bookmark caps, no billing. Docker image, single container, embedded SQLite.
marketing.pricing.subheadline: Start free, self-host for nothing, or pay for more when you need it.
marketing.pricing.supporter_body: Everything in Personal — unlimited bookmarks, custom slugs, API access — permanently. One payment, no subscription, no renewal.
